_about: B-19 emulator profiles (data only: a new emulator is a new entry). Each option comes from the emulator's own source; see docs/EMULATORS.md for the files and commits. 'present' lists the spellings that mean the option is already in the shortcut (never added twice). 'needs' lists spellings one of which must already be there (e.g. Dolphin's -b requires -e).

profiles.name: Dolphin
guide: Opens the game directly: the shortcut must use -e "<game file>" (without it, -b does nothing and Dolphin shows its game list).
Start-up pop-ups: Dolphin's update check is a setting (Config → General → Auto Update, "Don't Update"); it can't be set from the command line safely.
Controller: Controllers → GameCube / Wii: set your pad once in Dolphin.

profiles.name: Cemu
guide: Opens the game directly: the shortcut must use -g "<game>".
Stopping closes the emulator: Cemu has no command-line option for this; close Cemu's window (or use Close Software) to end the game.
No confirm on stop, start-up pop-ups: not command-line options in Cemu; check Options → General Settings.
Controller: Options → Input Settings.

profiles.name: DuckStation
guide: Opens the game directly: the shortcut must end with the game's file.
No confirm on stop, start-up pop-ups, controller: check DuckStation's settings (Settings → Interface, Settings → Controllers).

profiles.name: PCSX2
guide: Opens the game directly: the shortcut must end with the game's file.
No confirm on stop, start-up pop-ups, controller: check PCSX2's settings (Settings → Interface, Settings → Controllers).

profiles.name: Azahar
guide: Azahar opens a game given as its only argument; it has -f / --fullscreen, but adding it beside the game may stop Azahar from opening the game, so AIONE adds nothing until that is checked.
Fullscreen, no confirm on stop, start-up pop-ups, controller: set them in Azahar's settings.

profiles.name: Eden
guide: Not verified yet: Eden's source isn't on GitHub (git.eden-emu.dev), which this build could not read. Nothing is added; set fullscreen and the rest in Eden's settings.
